race.title: Coral 'Bet10 Get50 Sign Up Offer' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Cases can be made for a few but ETALON has been in better heart than recent form figures would suggest, far from discredited when a never-nearer fourth at Aintree 3 weeks ago. Back down to his last winning mark with cheekpieces refitted, he could be ready to strike, with confidence behind him in the market likely to bolster that view. Exeter scorer Kap Ouest is easily one of the least exposed and feared on return, with last year's winner Twinjets another expected to play a lead role. ETALON (IRE) KAP OUEST (FR) TWINJETS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Kap Ouest (9/4), Twinjets (4/1), Bluey (4/1), Etalon (5/1), Teddy Blue (7/1), Gemirande (16/1), Issar D'Airy (16/1), Le Patron (20/1)
